_provenance.what: failure_category labels for the 20 OpenBookQA items newly admitted to the RQ1 flagged pool by criterion C3_prior_dependent, which could not be applied when the original artefact was built.
_provenance.annotator: second annotator (Claude, this session) - NOT the annotator who labelled the original 408 items
_provenance.rubric: the reconstructed operational definitions in docs/failure_taxonomy_methodology.md section 4.1
_provenance.known_risk: these 20 labels come from a different annotator than the other 80 OBQA labels, using a rubric reconstructed after the fact. Mixing them into a single distribution introduces an annotator effect that did not exist before. Reported separately in docs/failure_taxonomy_methodology.md section 6.1 for this reason.
_provenance.note_on_category_availability: option_leakage and parametric_knowledge received zero items here, consistent with the original OBQA pool (which also had zero parametric_knowledge).

27.rationale: Which body system supplies oxygen is elementary-curriculum biology; 'the school system' is a joke distractor.

74.rationale: Three distractors are absurd for a FALLEN leaf (turns into a tree, becomes bright green, continues to grow); the gold is the only physically sensible option and also the longest.

171.rationale: Two distractors are jokes (wishing, magic); friction vs metal for starting a fire is elementary.

191.rationale: Conservation increases availability; the gold is the only option with that polarity. Primary model already at P(R^q)=0.951.

202.rationale: Only one option names a mechanism at all; elementary inheritance.

226.rationale: Odd-one-out: the gold is the only option describing actual bone movement (resting, hair growth, invisible smiles are not).

251.rationale: Distractors (Walking, Water, Chips) are absurd as pollution sources.

253.rationale: The stem already states the action ('putting one kind of soda into the same cup as another'); the fact merely restates that pouring one substance into another is combining.

329.rationale: Xylem transports water; school-level botany. The only water-related option.

389.rationale: Distractors (fun, taste, soil) are absurd; food and water supply energy is elementary.

394.rationale: Polarity odd-one-out: renewed/retrieved/restored are all restorative, the gold is the only removal, and 'tears down' echoes 'is removed'.

399.rationale: The Moon is the nearest body; common knowledge.

403.rationale: The gold is the only coherent purpose; the distractors are circular ('use heat energy', 'burn energy').

408.rationale: Global warming reduces ice; elementary and widely known.

422.rationale: One full moon per month is common knowledge.

426.rationale: Octopus concealment (ink/camouflage) is common elementary knowledge; the other options are ordinary visible animals.

442.rationale: A classroom clock counting down measures seconds; days/weeks/years are absurd for a clock.

447.rationale: The stem is logically self-sufficient: 'less than a minute' eliminates day, minute and hour by arithmetic alone. The fact adds nothing.

483.rationale: Steam is water vapor; elementary states of matter.
